topic: 5 Free AI Tools for Making Presentations Faster
subject: 5 Free AI Tools for Making Presentations Faster
audience: Students and office workers who build decks on deadline, have heard of Gamma or Canva, and assume the free AI versions are either useless trials or watermark traps
core_value: Which free AI tool handles which slow part of a deck (the draft, the file, the edits, the layout, the diagrams), and exactly where each free plan stops
desired_action: Save the reel for the next deck
tone: Plain, specific, practical. No ranking, no 'game changer'. The catch is stated as calmly as the feature.
footage_constraints: ANIMATED TREATMENT: facePlan bookends (presenter in the corner circle on the hook and the CTA end card), `slide` scenes for the five tools, music bed on, captions on. Proof is each vendor's own published screenshot or demo (Gamma help-centre demo, Anthropic's settings toggle, Pitch agent panel, Microsoft's Designer before/after, Napkin's in-deck diagram). These are desktop web apps: vendor screenshots are cropped and moved (screen block focus), never fitted whole.
